purpose: Connect reusable data, clocks, identities, events, state transitions, candidate contracts and evidence provenance so the OS can reuse validated structural work without conflating mechanisms or scientific authority.
principle: share deterministic infrastructure, not scientific conclusions

reusable_components.description: SEC acceptance timestamp at the admissible public filing boundary.
reusable_components.evidence: Q218 source gate receipt; Q121 dual-index work provides independent population anchors.
reusable_components.reuse_rule: Clock semantics may be reused; candidate-specific event pairing and same-day interpretation remain separate gates.

reusable_components.description: Immutable as-filed SEC filing prefix at the public boundary.
reusable_components.evidence: Q218/Q220 candidate contracts and SEC filing archive gates.
reusable_components.reuse_rule: Later amendments/current text may not rewrite the historical prefix.

reusable_components.evidence: Q111/Q112/Q121 identity architecture and current candidate contracts.
reusable_components.reuse_rule: Mapping may be reused only when the candidate-specific semantic identity contract is satisfied.

reusable_components.description: Historical SEC 10-K plus earnings-release 8-K channel archive with acceptance metadata.
reusable_components.evidence: Q218 source gate observed all 8 issuer channels and fixed acceptance timestamps.
reusable_components.reuse_rule: Reuse only the observed source structure; event pairing, amendment lineage and PIT remain candidate-specific.

reusable_components.description: XBRL text-block tags and presentation/relationship structure from as-filed filing datasets.
reusable_components.evidence: Q220 FSN schema gate and Q104 XBRL infrastructure.
reusable_components.reuse_rule: Mappings must remain deterministic; free-form post-outcome semantic reassignment is prohibited.

reusable_components.description: Pinned historical options input chain with independent PIT reproduction.
reusable_components.reuse_rule: EOD observations cannot be treated as same-session information without a separately proven tighter clock.

reusable_components.description: USAspending/FPDS public-observation publication chain including agency-specific delay exceptions.
reusable_components.reuse_rule: DoD/USACE and other exceptions must be classified before candidate PIT use.
Compiler output is structural metadata until candidate-specific PIT and identity gates pass.

reusable_components.description: Deterministic Treasury auction demand state representation.
reusable_components.reuse_rule: State representation may be reused; no outcome inference is inherited.

candidate_relations.scientific_interpretation: Infrastructure reuse only; Q218 studies channel allocation, Q220 studies narrative/structured representation.
A common SEC event anchor can align a post-filing market response; it does not imply mechanism equivalence.
Representation state and options response form separate observable endpoints; any composite requires both candidate-specific PIT contracts.
USAspending clock reuse is permitted; R&D-option-value and financing-constraint mechanisms remain distinct.
Q116 is a population/application layer over the deterministic 13F transition compiler.

discovery_motifs.rule: Candidate is about the state transition between channels, not a generic event count.
Response source clock must be independently proven; same-day leakage is fail-closed.
Exposure mapping must be pre-event and reproducible; action dates are not public-observation clocks.
Do not collapse representations into one factor; preserve channel-specific provenance and gates.

orchestration_rules.shared_component_rule: A structural prerequisite may be computed once and reused by every dependent candidate, with candidate-specific downstream validation.
orchestration_rules.no_transitive_authority: Passing a shared component never passes a dependent candidate's PIT, performance or authorization gate.
orchestration_rules.cross_candidate_composition: Never create a composite candidate merely because graph edges exist. Components must first pass their own candidate-specific gates; any composition requires a separate frozen contract.
orchestration_rules.negative_evidence_inheritance: A failed source contract may close all dependent candidate paths until a new falsifiable source route is declared.
orchestration_rules.independent_reproduction: Critical shared components should be reproduced once by an independent route before being treated as reusable structural infrastructure.
orchestration_rules.scheduler_use: Prioritize unresolved shared components with the highest number of blocked independent downstream tasks, but do not use performance outcomes to set this priority.

temporal_identity_state_spine.rule: Every reusable event/state relation should resolve to an explicit public clock, identity mapping and state/revision lineage before candidate-specific PIT use.
